name: urban-rooftop-high-fashion-selfie
image_purpose: high-fashion social portrait and rooftop reference

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic close-up rooftop selfie using the attached approved-adult reference image.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult female subject preserving the reference face, facial structure, hair and natural features; confident relaxed gaze, natural-to-polished makeup and pastel or neutral fashionable top with minimal jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered close-up selfie with head slightly tilted, hand relaxed near face, modern rooftop with pastel walls, geometric lines, soft neon accents and glass railings behind, no typography.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight from the right with subtle shadows, warm skin tones and pastel/neon background accents, high-fashion modern social aesthetic.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical close-up smartphone selfie, wide-angle lens, f/1.8–f/2.2 look, sharp face, shallow background blur, realistic color and motion.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical close-up rooftop selfie of the approved adult subject from the attached reference, preserving face, facial structure, hair and natural identity, wearing a fashionable pastel or neutral top with minimal jewelry, head slightly tilted with relaxed hand near face, modern city rooftop with pastel walls, geometric architectural lines, soft neon accents and glass railings, soft daylight from the right, warm skin tones, shallow background blur, confident high-fashion social portrait, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, child, minor, identity drift, different face, distorted anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, watermark, text, logo
